label: Tooling foundations & evidence
description: Choose tools by the evidence layer you need, capture reproducible artifacts safely, and know when investigation mutates state.
descriptionUk: Обирайте інструменти за потрібним evidence layer, безпечно фіксуйте відтворювані artifacts і розумійте, коли investigation змінює state.

label: HTTP & API request tools
description: Build reproducible requests with curl, Postman and Bruno, then share them without coupling tests to one desktop client.
descriptionUk: Будуйте reproducible requests через curl, Postman і Bruno та діліться ними без прив’язки test knowledge до одного desktop client.

label: Browser DevTools & debugging
description: Inspect DOM, console, network, storage, sources, performance and security signals using browser developer tools, with Chrome as the primary example.
descriptionUk: Inspect DOM, console, network, storage, sources, performance і security signals через browser developer tools, використовуючи Chrome як основний приклад.

label: HTTP interception & proxies
description: Capture, inspect, replay and deliberately modify HTTP(S) traffic using Fiddler Everywhere, Charles or mitmproxy while respecting TLS and privacy boundaries.
descriptionUk: Capture, inspect, replay і свідомо modify HTTP(S) traffic через Fiddler Everywhere, Charles або mitmproxy з урахуванням TLS та privacy boundaries.

label: Database & data inspection
description: Investigate persisted state safely with a SQL client and reconcile database evidence with API and UI behavior.
descriptionUk: Безпечно досліджуйте persisted state через SQL client і reconcile database evidence з API та UI behavior.

label: Network packet analysis
description: Use Wireshark, tshark and tcpdump when the question sits below HTTP: TCP behavior, DNS, TLS visibility and packet timing.
descriptionUk: Використовуйте Wireshark, tshark і tcpdump, коли питання нижче HTTP: TCP behavior, DNS, TLS visibility і packet timing.

label: Mobile & device diagnostics
description: Use adb, Logcat and Apple Simulator/Instruments as device-level evidence bridges without duplicating the full Mobile curriculum.
descriptionUk: Використовуйте adb, Logcat і Apple Simulator/Instruments як device-level evidence bridges без дублювання повного Mobile curriculum.

label: Specialist-tool bridges
description: Recognize when to hand off to performance, security, accessibility, automation or integration tooling without duplicating those curricula.
descriptionUk: Розпізнавайте момент handoff до performance, security, accessibility, automation або integration tooling без дублювання окремих curricula.

label: Performance & load testing with Locust
labelUk: Performance та load testing з Locust
description: Learn Locust from the real GimmeJob workload: virtual users, task weights and tags, pacing, RPS, response validation, production safety, thresholds and scenario expansion.
descriptionUk: Вивчіть Locust на реальному workload GimmeJob: virtual users, task weights і tags, pacing, RPS, response validation, production safety, thresholds та розширення scenarios.
